# 00000007739

**FRV-19 ★** — source: 243_高维随机矩阵VIII_自由随机变量.md

**English.** Definition: The free Khintchine inequalities compare L^p and L^2 norms of noncommutative martingale polynomials: for free words W of length d generated by free semicircular families, M_p(d) = ||W||_p/||W||_2. Conjecture: M_4(d)^2 = 2 - d^{-1}(1 - (1/2)^d), the exact free refinement of the fourth-moment theorem; and the limit ratio spectrum of M_inf(d)/M_p(d) as d grows characterizes the operator-norm concentration of products of free group generators. (exact free Khintchine fourth moment)

**中文。** 定义：自由 Khintchine 不等式比较非交换鞅多项式的 L^p 范数与其 L^2 范数：对自由半圆族生成的长度 d 的自由 Word W，比率 M_p(d)=||W||_p/||W||_2 的最优常数。猜想：M_4(d)² = 2 - d^{-1}·(1-(1/2)^d)（即四阶矩定理的自由精确化），且 M_∞(d)/M_p(d) 在 d→∞ 时的极限比率谱刻画了自由群生成元乘积的算子范数集中现象。
